identity_note: Parent hashes identify the original frozen release, not this privacy-cleaned distribution. Original receipts and archives are preserved separately and not rewritten.
scope: Documentation, package metadata, CI and four test-file adjustments: optional external-fixture paths, generalized path privacy assertion and acceptance of the existing MOL2 provenance-comment prefix. No production algorithm or runtime data changes.
exclusion_note: Local/historical QA records, source-root metadata, obsolete internal packaging/planning documents, a backup and optional Windows Vina binaries are not copied into this candidate. Runtime resources are retained.
